paragraphs.dominant_move: states two goals and one scope before any method
credits the result to a named census file
decomposes the problem into six numbered sub-problems
claims one objective does not hurt the others
restates the six sub-problems as the plan

global_organization_chain: Name the fear, then answer it with a magnitude
Keep a random draw as the control and drop a rule the control does not support
Tell the century as a sequence of generations before showing the equations
Narrow the search on purpose and say why before running it
Turn a hole in the data into the timing of the policy

main_argument_chains.claim: A filtered founding group, a wage floor of 33526 and parental leave of 50200, with immigrants phased at 10000 every ten years, balances output against happiness.
support_steps: Weight income, schooling and equality by word frequency and a checked hierarchy
Filter the founders and beat a random draw on income spread and schooling
Simulate jobs, marriages and births and read the sixty-year slump
Solve the three objectives and take the reported point
Phase the migration so each wave fills the age gap and finds work
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Adopt the floor, the leave pay and the phased plan, and treat missing resources and health care as open gaps.
